blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the fresh V87 sit and crouch renders shows substantial thigh exposure. The matching-pose surface-ray audit measures shorts coverage at sit L/R 13.11%/13.11% and crouch L/R 16.72%/16.72%. Overskirt coverage remains sit 18.64%/18.53% and crouch 32.77%/32.88%. These readings do not establish fit or usable coverage.

Direct inspection of the V87 neutral, sit, and crouch renders shows the under-shorts do not form a continuous, leg-following covering surface in the posed images; exposed upper thighs remain prominent and the gusset/hem is not visually validated for use.

Direct inspection of front, back, left, right, and three-quarter views shows pronounced accordion-like side corrugation and projecting, irregular hem corners. The fabric silhouette reads as a prototype with uneven drape.

The actual V87 Blender build report records passed=false and REJECT: avatar fit, deformation weights, and zero-unweighted-vertex checks fail. The rendered appearance does not override those geometry gates; UV, shape-key, Unity, and VRChat behavior remain unverified.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
